text: じゅうじボタンで　いけそうに　ない　ところでも　おもいきって　むかって　いってみましょう！

structure.jp: じゅうじボタンで　いけそうに　ない　ところでも
structure.en: even places the D-pad doesn't look able to take you

patterns.name: 〜そうにない
patterns.explanation: そうにない on the stem of a verb says it does not look as if that will happen. いけそうに　ない = 'doesn't look like you can go'.

patterns.name: 〜でも
patterns.explanation: でも after a thing means 'even' that thing. ところでも = 'even a place'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb with みる means to try doing something to see what happens. いってみましょう = 'let's try going'.
